text:
marco: flagging a subtle one: truncated stream + immediate retry resulted in two toolcall charges but ledger reconciliation didn't dedupe because confirmed token count dropped after suffix trimming.
izzy: can you show the minimal trace?
marco: short: client streamed -> server finished with a truncation FIN at token 1203 and wrote provisional_charge(tokens=1203). client retried immediately. on retry we routed to a different shard which ran the toolcall; final ledger shows confirmed_charge(tokens=1199) because downstream post-processing removed a trailing safety token block. reconciliation didn't match the provisional and both rows remained.
devon: so mismatch in token counts prevented our naive match. ledger currently matches provisional to confirmed by session+approx-token-eq.
ledger-bot: INFO ledger: provisional(session=mrc-11,id=pc_aa12,tokens=1203)
ledger-bot: INFO ledger: confirmed(session=mrc-11,id=cc_bb34,tokens=1199)
sasha: ouch. two problems: (1) dedupe lost because reconnect routed to a different shard, (2) reconciliation heuristics are brittle when token counts shift slightly.
izzy: quick UX mitigation: show provisional rows grouped by session in the console and label rows with reconciled=false so support sees duplicates. add a tooltip: "may be reconciled even if token count differs slightly".
marco: long term ideas: (A) ledger accepts an optional dedupe_key on provisional writes that survives token shifts, (B) compute a server-side toolcall-fingerprint (HMAC of session+canonicalized-prompt+call-spec) and use that as dedupe_key, (C) make router attempt to preserve shard affinity for reconnects within a short window.
devon: option C is cheap but brittle for real failovers. B + ledger change seems robust: even if token counts change, dedupe_key ties the two records.
izzy: ledger change is invasive. Another middleground: router emits X-Dedupe-Key derived server-side and we write it to provisional. ledger reconciler considers dedupe_key equality as primary match, token counts as secondary.
ledger-bot: NOTE ledger: we can add an optional "dedupe_key" field on provisional rows and reconcile by it. potential backwards compat concerns noted.
sasha: alternative novel idea: short-lived "dedupe gossip" backend. when a shard issues provisional_charge it publishes the dedupe_key to a fast TTL store (e.g., 60s) sharded by org. receiving shards probe that store for dedupe_key before executing side-effects. it's cheaper than synchronous cross-shard RPC and avoids touching the global ledger logic for quick fixes.
marco: I like gossip approach for speed. constraints: TTL must be small (60s), privacy/salt for dedupe_key, and probe latency must be tiny (<10ms).
izzy: operational concerns: gossip store is another component to run and scale; but can be colocated as a tiny Redis cluster per region and only hold salted hashes.
devon: implementation plan hybrid: 1) router/server compute canonicalized toolcall fingerprint -> dedupe_key (HMAC with org salt). 2) provisional write includes dedupe_key. 3) shard publishes dedupe_key to regional gossip store with 60s TTL at provisional time. 4) on reconnect, receiving shard checks local cache -> gossip store probe -> if dedupe hit, short-circuit toolcall and synthesize deduped response. 5) ledger also uses dedupe_key when reconciling.
ledger-bot: ACTION ledger: schedule PR to accept dedupe_key on provisional writes and include it in reconciliation pipeline.
ux: console changes: badge "provisional" + grouped view when dedupe_key present; tooltip copy: "pending reconciliation; may be merged with confirmed charge if dedupe matches". also add support CTA to expedite refunds.
ops-bot: requirement: dedupe probes must be best-effort and bounded (timeout 50ms). add feature flag to toggle gossip probing per-customer.
izzy: tests: e2e sim: truncate stream, immediate retry routed to another shard, assert single net toolcall after gossip+dedupe. unit test: ledger reconciliation should match by dedupe_key even when token counts differ by up to N tokens.
marco: opened INF-17421 with traces and suggested hybrid plan. tagging ledger, routing, ui, and infra. proposing canary: enable gossip probe for 1% of reconnects for 24h. monitor metric "provisional_minus_confirmed_by_org" and P99 latency.
devon: note: we should also log in traces when route changed on retry so support can quickly triage. console trace view should surface "route-change-on-retry" flag.
sasha: and document trade-offs in routing SLO doc: availability vs dedupe correctness; product decision required for default sticky-window.
marco: thanks. P2, customer impacted but workaround exists (support refund). Will schedule follow-ups after infra scoping. :thumbsup:
